audience: product and growth teams that read event, funnel and retention data from one Amplitude project

useCases.title: Count events and users
useCases.text: List the event types of a project. Count one event, or compare two events, over a date range.

useCases.title: Measure funnels and retention
useCases.text: Measure the conversion through an ordered list of events. Measure how many users return after a start action.

useCases.title: Track active users and revenue
useCases.text: Count active or new users per day, week or month. Read the revenue per user, per paying user, or in total.

useCases.title: Break down users by a property
useCases.text: Split the users of a date range by one property, such as country, platform or app version.

useCases.title: Look up the activity of one user
useCases.text: Find users by Amplitude ID, device ID or user ID. Read the event stream of one user, newest first.
